l.i: Videamus imprimis quibus modis aliqua fiant.

page.notes: Printed line "Quaedam" in the first paragraph has a wrapped hyphen form; the Greek words in "Quotuplex" are reproduced from the scan as best read, with the final "εὐτυχία" and "ἀυτυχία" uncertain; the Greek word for good fortune is partly illegible. Line 4 has a small corrupt letter in "fierere"; the scan shows "fortasse fierere" and may be misprinted. The paragraph ends on a catchword "fortuna" at the right foot, not transcribed as text.
